title: Israeli Declaration of Independence
summary: On 14 May 1948, David Ben-Gurion, head of the Jewish Agency, proclaimed the State of Israel at Tel Aviv, as the British Mandate over Palestine ended. US President Harry Truman recognized it the same day. In the 1948 war involving neighbouring Arab states, Israel expanded to 77 percent of mandate Palestine, and over half of the Palestinian Arab population fled or were expelled.

uncertainty.note: The declaration is dated 14 May 1948 and took effect at the end of the Mandate that night.

as_recorded.value: Issued at Tel Aviv on May 14, 1948 (5th of Iyar, 5708)
On May 14, 1948, David Ben-Gurion , the head of the Jewish Agency, proclaimed the establishment of the State of Israel

importance.justification: Founded the State of Israel, an event at the centre of the 1948 war and the continuing question of Palestine.
